summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson was admitted for a right ureteral stone requiring surgical intervention. Given his mechanical aortic valve and chronic anticoagulation with Coumadin, he was admitted early for a heparin bridge. He underwent right ureteroscopy with laser lithotripsy and stent placement on January 19 without complications. Postoperatively, he was transitioned back to Coumadin with overlapping heparin until his INR reached the therapeutic range of 2.5–3.5. His hospital course was uncomplicated, with stable management of comorbidities including diastolic heart failure, COPD, diabetes, and coronary artery disease. He was discharged home in stable condition with instructions to follow up with his PCP for INR monitoring and urology for stent removal.
